summary: A granite tower on a half-tide ledge off Cape Elizabeth, built 1903-05 after three groundings; automated 1959 and sold at federal auction in 2010.

access.note: Privately owned since 2010 auction; not open to the public.

notes_for_editor: Roster is USLHS/NARA (facts only), not independently confirmed in the registers; only keepers named in primary reports (Dewyea, Lovatt) and Tapley/Alley via LighthouseFriends are tied to events. Construction detail, 1927 rescue date and lens details come from LighthouseFriends only; Lighthouse Board reports for 1902-1905 are not in the local corpus (ends 1901). 1927 Bulletin OCR is garbled (two columns) and gives 'August 8' near a different item; only the index entry is used. The 1903 LSS narrative does not name the schooner; the Cora and Lillian match is by date/place in the casualty table. 1900 LSS passage does not name the steamer. NRHP says 'California', LighthouseFriends 'Californian'. Height: NRHP 77 ft to mid-lantern vs LF 70 ft to lantern deck; record has 22.0 m. Ownership: station record says private; the 2010 buyer was named by GSA but not confirmed, so not named. Newspaper search (Chronicling America) did not return in time.
